paper.title: Multi-Attention-Powered Learning Genetic Algorithm for Real-World 3D Wind Farm Layout Optimization

claim_boundary: This is a deterministic paper-guided engineering reconstruction. It is not the unavailable author ALGA implementation, learned state, real-world 3D Guishan problem, or a reproduction of reported objective values.

paper_preserved_controls.attention_equations: scaled dot-product softmax attention and concatenated multi-head output following paper Eqs. 19-23
paper_preserved_controls.paper_generation_mapping_physical_fes: 30 initial evaluations plus 100 generations times 24 evaluated non-elites equals 2430 complete-layout evaluations

declared_missing_field_completions.input: each evaluated layout is one sequence row; its sorted occupied-cell indices are divided by grid cardinality and centered at 0.5
declared_missing_field_completions.network_depth: one shallow multi-head attention layer and one linear scalar output; no hidden feed-forward layer
declared_missing_field_completions.target: per-generation min-max normalized complete-layout fitness; an all-equal population maps to one
declared_missing_field_completions.optimizer: deterministic vanilla full-batch gradient descent in fixed reduction order
declared_missing_field_completions.initialization: counter-keyed Xavier-uniform projections and output weights; zero scalar bias
declared_missing_field_completions.elite_count: six, equal to the 20 percent elite fraction in the public WFLO-GGA AGA predecessor
declared_missing_field_completions.crossover: fitness-tournament parent selection and public-predecessor one-point crossover
declared_missing_field_completions.mutation: with probability 0.1 replace one gene by one uniform grid cell before deterministic common repair
declared_missing_field_completions.individual_attention: equal mixture of normalized fitness and multi-head mean received attention
declared_missing_field_completions.cell_attention: mean individual-attention weight over evaluated layouts occupying the cell
declared_missing_field_completions.mask_cardinality: ceil(0.1 times turbine count), using the paper mutation degree as the smallest stated replacement fraction
declared_missing_field_completions.mask: lowest-cell-attention genes in each non-elite offspring
declared_missing_field_completions.high_potential_sequence: highest-cell-attention unoccupied cells appearing in the six current elites
declared_missing_field_completions.survival: copy six evaluated current elites and insert 24 independently generated, attention-guided, evaluated offspring
declared_missing_field_completions.tie_break: stable source order followed by ascending cell index
declared_missing_field_completions.repair: deduplicate, exclude unavailable cells, fill from counter-keyed uniform feasible cells, and sort ascending
declared_missing_field_completions.randomness: counter-keyed events independent of worker scheduling

primary_transfer.meaning: paper-visible 12 by 12 ideal grid, 500 m spacing, and 40-turbine scale; public WFLO-GGA Guishan annual wind probabilities; audited FODE-E0 turbine and Jensen/Park evaluator

platform_stress_transfer.meaning: shared 50-case platform problem, including the 80-turbine smoke case

missing: four seasonal and four ideal joint wind arrays

physical_work.unit: one completed feasible-layout call to the complete wind-distribution evaluator
physical_work.partial_terminal_generation: evaluate exactly the remaining requested layouts, retain the incumbent, and stop
physical_work.paper_native_budget: 2430 complete-layout evaluations under this reconstruction's six-elite generational semantics
physical_work.common_fixed_work_extension: 24000 complete-layout evaluations is a platform extension for equal-work comparison and is not the paper's native 100-generation protocol
physical_work.attention_training: no physical wind-farm evaluations and therefore zero additional physical FES

cpu.implementation: one persistent thread team parallelizes initialization, offspring state transitions, feasibility repair, and independent complete-layout/wind-state evaluation
cpu.admission: scientific semantics admitted; throughput admission pending an uncontended formal host

parallel_contract.worker_count_scientific_equivalence: exact best objective, best layout, physical FES, generation count, and learned-state hash
